profiles.core: Always-on harness behavior, safety, project context, and verification.
profiles.runtime-evidence: Real runtime run records linked to feature evidence for user-facing behavior.
profiles.verification-gate: Optional manual gate for DocsOnly, HarnessOnly, Runtime, Full, and BeforeCommit verification modes.
profiles.loop-policy: Project scaffold guidance for L1-L4 diagnosis and safe L4 loop admission with state, budget, isolation, maker-checker review, and stop conditions.
profiles.trace-eval-trends: Summaries and index files for comparing trace eval runs over time.
profiles.tool-failures: Structured tool failure records for recovery and repeated-failure triage.
profiles.skill-surface: Read-only stocktake of active skill count, trigger quality, provider-specific residue, and large skills.
profiles.codex-workflow-core: Codex-only workflow-control pack: hook router, agent pack, workflow entry, and self-tests.
profiles.hook-router: Metadata-only local hook event router with privacy-preserving Stop hook records.
profiles.scheduled-maintenance: Weekly Codex cron automation that runs harness health, bounded repairs, and verification.
profiles.agent-pack: Role-specific Codex sub-agents for planning, testing, E2E evidence, build repair, security, docs, harness audit, regressions, and cleanup.
profiles.workflow-entry: Command-style workflow script for plan, verify, TDD, E2E, review, security, learn, checkpoint, and orchestrate flows.
profiles.test-surface-detection: Project test surface detector that recommends build, typecheck, lint, unit, E2E, smoke, runtime, and harness checks.
profiles.coordination: Session handoff, worker run records, learning intake, and tool-surface discipline for long-running work.
profiles.research: Current web/docs research through approved search and documentation tools with explicit source-completeness evidence.
profiles.web-source-resolution: Global public-URL intake across projects with deterministic acquisition, MIME/signature classification, intent-aware routing, render-state detection, body fallback, and browser/document/data/media handoff.
profiles.article-source-resolution: Article-specific evidence grading, authorship, publication metadata, citation extraction, and blocked-page detection after web-source classification.
profiles.browser-runtime: Exploratory browser automation plus repeatable Playwright checks.
profiles.github-ops: Repository, PR, issue, and CI operations when requested.
profiles.docs-office: Document, spreadsheet, and presentation artifact workflows.
profiles.domain-plugin: Project-specific plugins or MCPs enabled only when relevant.
profiles.high-autonomy: Trusted local execution profile for known-safe repos and tasks.
